question: In the ATLAS measurement of lepton distributions in ttbar events at 8 TeV, which b-tagging algorithm was used, at what efficiency working point, and what rejection factor did it give against light-quark and gluon jets?
expect: MV1, 70% efficiency, rejection about 140 (about 5 against charm) (sec. 3)
rendered: Based on the document, the b-tagging algorithm used was a tagging working point corresponding to a 70% efficiency for tagging b-quark jets from top decays in t t̄ events. This gave a rejection factor of about 140 against light-quark and gluon jets, and about five against jets originating from charm quarks.
